change: Production native Rust QOI decoding validates framing and restores pixels in one pass. The standalone framing scanner and image QOI codec remain test-only timing references for this path.
backend: CPU and physical Metal Apple M4 Max
memory: Output admitted before allocation; shared owners retain credit; pressure refusal and all cancellation checkpoints release partial output; rejected corpus inputs end with zero retained budget.
large_sample_equality: Every RGBA byte of both 12 MP authored distributions compared to image codec in all 18 iterations each.
implementation: Fill an admitted pre-sized RGBA byte span per command; no unsafe code or additional decoded pixel buffer. Header/end marker checked before allocation, command/trailing checks in decoding loop, no command checkpoint removal.
limitations: CPU timing excludes filesystem I/O, GPU upload and presentation.
Concurrent machine builds affected timing; no universal speedup claim.
Separate reference-stage percentiles cannot be summed into an end-to-end percentile.
Timing requests have no cancellation token; injected cancellation and reservation lifecycle tested separately.
Photographic producer corpus, exhaustive malformed variants and physical HDR display remain unqualified.
